text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Pa, Ma! 
I'm baaaack home, ya hear!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Yukino Bijin invited me, 
I traveled to her hometown for some 
sightseeing.

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Yukino, and the Trainer too! 
Welcome, welcome! How've ya been keepin'?
choice_data_list: Yes! Doing well, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Father
text_block_list.text:
Well then, that's grand! Here, hand over 
your bags. 
Come on in and make yerselves at home.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Pa! 
Right, Trainer! Go on inside ahead of me!
choice_data_list: Ahead of you? Are you going somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've got chores I gotta take care of. 
See ya in a bit!

text_block_list.name: Cow
text_block_list.text: Moo-o-o-o-o-o-o-o.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aw, jeez, Trainer. 
You could've just kicked back and relaxed, 
ya know.
choice_data_list:
I couldn't help being curious. What are 
you doing, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Feedin' time! Over at our neighbor 
Yone-san's place! 
I've been doin' this ever since I was 
knee-high.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Didn't this fella just say "I'm hungry~" a 
second ago? 
...Well, maybe that was just me 
puttin' words in his mouth, though!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Eat up, eat up now! 
There's plenty of seconds where that came 
from!

text_block_list.name: Cow
text_block_list.text: Moo-o-o-o-o-o-o-o!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That settles that! 
Next up... I gotta go holler at folks down 
the market street!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text: Oh, Yukinko! You back home already?!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper B
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, if it isn't Yukinko! 
Look here, I got them dango dumplings you 
love so much!
choice_data_list: They sure are giving you a warm welcome.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's always like this whenever I 
come home! 
Everyone looks like they've just been 
waitin' for me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It just warms my heart right up... 
......

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, let's haul them veggies first! 
Then after that, we gotta weed around 
Tome-san's place!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I trained tons and tons in Tokyo! 
Ain't no job I can't handle!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Heave. ...Ho. 
Alright, that's the whole lot of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Urrrrgh... Phew... 
Plantin' rice by hand... haven't done that 
since I was a tot.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman with a Cane
text_block_list.text:
The machine went and broke down, so I 
thought we'd 
never make it in time... Thank you too, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Oh, it's nothing! I can do plenty more!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ! ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty! Maybe I'll go clear out 
the rice paddy irrigation ditches next!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, ever since returning to her 
hometown, 
Yukino Bijin hustled around helping the 
neighbors without taking a single break.
choice_data_list: Do you always help out this much?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! ...Er, but hold on! 
It's not tough or grueling at all, really!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
See, in a tiny town like this, 
everybody's basically family!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It feels like havin' whole bunches of mas 
and pas 
and brothers and sisters, so it's a real 
blast!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I just go around poppin' in here and 
there! 
Just havin' a good chinwag while I'm at 
it!
choice_data_list: You really love this place, don't you?
You really love this place, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Gosh, yes! More than anything!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Now, once we finish up here, there's 
another chore waitin'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRRAAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ouch-ouch-ouch... Things came tumblin' 
down like an avalanche...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, here they are, the records! 
They were tucked away in the back of the 
shed!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Well I'll be, thank you kindly! 
The records for the Chagu Chagu 
Umamusume... 
Ayup, this is the real deal alright!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The Chagu Chagu Umamusume...! 
That's right, it's comin' right up, ain't 
it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There'll be an Umamusume walkin' in a 
gorgeous kimono 
this year too, won't there! Ahh, I can't 
wait~~!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
We're all preparin' together this year 
too, 
so keep yer hopes up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Oooh! In that case, I'll sweep up 
the shrine grounds too! I'll make 'em 
sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ......Hwaaaah.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, s-sorry about that! 
That was mighty embarrassin'...
choice_data_list: You really are the local hero.
You really are the local hero.

You worked hard all day. Want something to 
drink?

You worked hard all day. Want something to 
drink?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, s-sorry about that! 
That was mighty embarrassin'...
choice_data_list: You really are the local hero.
You really are the local hero.

You worked hard all day. Want something to 
drink?

You worked hard all day. Want something to 
drink?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
! ...No way, no way! 
Callin' me a hero is layin' it on thick!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If anyone is, that'd be you, Trainer! 
...Thank you so much for runnin' around 
with me all day today!
choice_data_list:
Don't mention it. I just wanted to help 
you out.

Don't mention it. I just wanted to help 
you out.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even so, stickin' with me till the end... 
Aw, thank ya kindly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm just gettin' started, ya hear! 
Tomorrow I gotta work even harder~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Let's give it our aaaaaall, ayup!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Oh, that's it! 
I sure could go for some milk from home!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wanna have some with me, Trainer? 
Fresh milk tastes mighty good!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really?! You mean it?! 
Whoa, what should I get?!
choice_data_list: Anything you want. Go on, get a big one.
Anything you want. Go on, get a big one.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't drink that much! ...Still, 
hehe. 
You sure are sweet, Trainer!
